interface.label: Git hosting
interface.description: Version control: the Aprovan default serves the workspace commit store (commit/log/show/diff/branches/restore) in-process; third-party hosts (GitHub, …) remain selectable backends built on @utdk/vcs. Credentials stay keyed by the concrete provider (github), so a connected GitHub account just works.

compat.label: Bitbucket
compat.unavailable: The Bitbucket adapter module is not built yet. The contract is @utdk/vcs; the mapping to Bitbucket's REST API does not exist.
